brief:
According to Shehab Wire, sources within the Radaa force reported that families working under Ashraf al-Mansi, commander of the group calling itself the "Popular Army — Northern Forces," have surrendered to security agencies in Gaza. Al-Mansi's faction is accused of cooperating with Israeli forces.

The surrenders occur as rival armed groups and security forces continue competing for control across eastern Gaza. Radaa, a force operating in the territory, has previously engaged in operations against armed factions and groups it accuses of collaboration with the occupation. The circumstances prompting the families' decision to turn themselves in remain unclear.
